name: Totally Accurate Kissing Booth Simulator
storyline:
Ooh la la! Can you deliver the perfect kiss? Run a kissing booth to raise money for charity while you try to kiss crushes from your Secret Crush Diary. Remember, this is a totally accurate Kissing Booth Simulator so the more accurate you are the more tips you will earn. Kissing experience is helpful but not required.

Keep your diary up to date with your latest kisses. Kiss accurately to maintain interest... kiss poorly to say goodbye.

Watch out! You have a rival in town running a competing kissing booth and they're trying to steal your crushes! Or are they?
summary: A totally accurate kissing booth simulator for the Playdate console where you kiss procedurally generated faces while trying to kiss crushes from your Secret Crush Diary.
